page.title: Tunnels
page.description: Publish a service that runs behind NAT through one of your servers with a public address.

empty.title: No tunnels yet
empty.description: A tunnel lets a service at home or behind a router answer on a hostname, through a server the internet can reach.

list.statusFailed: The tunnel's state could not be read.

setup.title: Open UDP port {port} on {server}
setup.body: Polaris cannot open ports at your hosting provider. Add an inbound rule to this server's firewall or security group with these values. This notice goes away at the first handshake.
setup.down: No handshake for a while. Check that UDP port {port} is still open on {server} and that the server running {service} is on.
setup.dns: Point {hostname} at {address} with an {record} record so visitors reach it.

dialog.title: New tunnel
dialog.description: Visitors reach the hostname on the public server, which passes them through an encrypted tunnel to the service.
dialog.publicHint: A server with a public address. It receives visitors and listens on one UDP port.
dialog.serviceHint: Runs on a different server, usually behind NAT. Nothing is opened there.
dialog.noOtherServer: Every service runs on this server. A tunnel needs a service on another one.
dialog.hostnameInvalid: Enter a hostname such as app.example.com.

remove.title: Remove this tunnel?
remove.question: {hostname} stops answering and both ends are removed. The service itself is not touched.

refusals.noServer: That server is not one of yours.
refusals.noService: That service is not one of yours.
refusals.sameServer: The service already runs on that server. Pick a service on another server.
refusals.hostname: Enter a hostname such as app.example.com.
refusals.hostnameTaken: That hostname is already in use.
refusals.full: No free tunnel port is left on that server.
refusals.noAddress: The public address of that server is not known yet.
refusals.unreachable: That server cannot be reached right now.
refusals.edge: That server's edge does not take routes from Polaris yet. Set it up again from Servers.
refusals.leftover: The tunnel is paused, but {servers} could not be cleaned up. Remove it again once it is back.
refusals.leftoverPaused: The tunnel is paused, but its end on {servers} is still running. Pause it again once it is back.
refusals.generic: The tunnel could not be changed. Try again in a moment.

retired.leftover: The tunnel for {hostname} could not be cleaned up on {servers}.
retired.notMoved: The tunnel for {hostname} did not start where its service now runs. It is paused; resume it from Tunnels.
